questions.prompt: Show that f(x)=sin x is odd and state the cosine coefficients.
questions.answer: Evaluate at negative x: \[f(-x)=\sin(-x)=-\sin x=-f(x)\] Thus f is odd. Since cos nx is even, the product f(x) cos nx is odd, so \[a_n=\frac{1}{\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}f(x)\cos nx\,dx=0\] Also a_0=0.

questions.prompt: A signal has f(-x)=-f(x). Which Fourier terms remain?
questions.answer: The signal is odd. The constant term and cosine terms vanish, leaving only sine terms: \[f(x)\sim\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}b_n\sin nx\]
